subgradient_norm_le_lipschitz_ball.statement: theorem subgradient_norm_le_lipschitz_ball (f : E → EReal) (x : E) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (K : ℝ≥0) (hfinite : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, ∃ a : ℝ, f y = (a : EReal)) (hlip : LipschitzOnWith K (fun y => (f y).toReal) (Metric.ball x r)) (g : E) (hg : g ∈ SourceSubdifferential f x) : ‖g‖ ≤ (K : ℝ)

subgradients_locally_bounded.statement: theorem subgradients_locally_bounded (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ y, f y ≠ ⊥) (hf : IsConvexExtended f) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ interior (effectiveDomain f)) : ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, ∀ g ∈ SourceSubdifferential f y, ‖g‖ ≤ (K : ℝ)

subgradient_limit_of_continuousAt.statement: theorem subgradient_limit_of_continuousAt {ι : Type*} (l : Filter ι) [NeBot l] (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ y, f y ≠ ⊥) (x g : E) (hx : x ∈ interior (effectiveDomain f)) (hcont : ContinuousAt (fun y => (f y).toReal) x) (xs gs : ι → E) (hxs : Tendsto xs l (𝓝 x)) (hgs : Tendsto gs l (𝓝 g)) (hs : ∀ᶠ i in l, gs i ∈ SourceSubdifferential f (xs i)) : g ∈ SourceSubdifferential f x

singleton_subgradient_tendsto.statement: theorem singleton_subgradient_tendsto {ι : Type*} (l : Filter ι) [NeBot l] (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ y, f y ≠ ⊥) (hf : IsConvexExtended f) (x g : E) (hx : x ∈ interior (effectiveDomain f)) (hg : SourceSubdifferential f x = {g}) (xs gs : ι → E) (hxs : Tendsto xs l (𝓝 x)) (hs : ∀ᶠ i in l, gs i ∈ SourceSubdifferential f (xs i)) : Tendsto gs l (𝓝 g)

singleton_subdifferential_interior.statement: theorem singleton_subdifferential_interior (f : E → EReal) (hf : IsConvexExtended f) (x : E) (hx : ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)) (g : E) (hg : SourceSubdifferential f x = {g}) : x ∈ interior (effectiveDomain f)

singleton_subdifferential_hasGradientAt.statement: theorem singleton_subdifferential_hasGradientAt (f : E → EReal) (hf : IsConvexExtended f) (x : E) (hx : ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)) (g : E) (hg : SourceSubdifferential f x = {g}) : HasGradientAt (fun y => (f y).toReal) g x

sourceDifferentiableAt_regular.statement: theorem sourceDifferentiableAt_regular (f : E → EReal) (x : E) (hd : SourceDifferentiableAt f x) : (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∃ r : ℝ, f y = (r : EReal)) ∧ x ∈ interior (effectiveDomain f) ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (f y).toReal) x

subgradient_eq_gradient_at_interior.statement: theorem subgradient_eq_gradient_at_interior (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ z, f z ≠ ⊥) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ interior (effectiveDomain f)) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (f z).toReal) x) (g : E) (hg : g ∈ SourceSubdifferential f x) : g = gradient (fun z => (f z).toReal) x

theorem_2_22_gradient.statement: theorem theorem_2_22_gradient (f : E → EReal) (hf : IsConvexExtended f) (x : E) (hx : ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)) (h : E → ℝ) (he : (fun y => (h y : EReal)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] f) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ h x) : SourceSubdifferential f x = {gradient h x}

theorem_2_22_forward.statement: theorem theorem_2_22_forward (f : E → EReal) (hf : IsConvexExtended f) (x : E) (hx : ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)) (hd : SourceDifferentiableAt f x) : ∃ g : E, SourceSubdifferential f x = {g}

theorem_2_22.statement: theorem theorem_2_22 (f : E → EReal) (hf : IsConvexExtended f) (x : E) (hx : ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)) : SourceDifferentiableAt f x ↔ ∃ g : E, SourceSubdifferential f x = {g}
